v44_bow.description: Survival, a bow in hotbar slot 1 and 16 arrows in slot 9, looking level south over the v43 platform; selects 1 and holds use for 20 ticks. Expect CLIENT_ACTION step=hold result=started input=use, then result=done heldTicks=20 released=done, and 15 arrows left in INVENTORY_INSPECT (one shot: survival uses an arrow per shot). Run v43_platform first.

v44_hold_next.description: Survival, looking 45 degrees down at the stone floor, holds attack for 100 ticks; 40 ticks later a select of slot 2 arrives. Expect the hold released=nextAction with heldTicks about 40, before the select's done. Run v43_platform first.

v44_hold_screen.description: Survival with the bow of v44_bow, holds use for 200 ticks and cues the person to open their inventory. Expect the hold released=screenOpen when the inventory opens, then the close done. Run v44_bow first.
commands: devtool checkpoint cue OPEN_INVENTORY_NOW title sound

v44_hold_died.description: Survival with the bow, holds use for 200 ticks; 20 ticks later the caller is killed. Expect the hold released=died, then a respawn done. Run v44_bow first.

v44_drop.description: Survival, 10 dirt in hotbar slot 2, selected; drops one, then the rest. Expect CLIENT_ACTION step=drop all=false held=minecraft:dirt heldCount=10, then all=true heldCount=9, item entities near the caller (the first one item, then the stack of nine), and slot 2 empty in INVENTORY_INSPECT. Run v43_platform first.

v44_delay_shot.description: Creative, 16 stone in slot 3, looking 45 degrees down: an attack on air delayed 40 ticks (the server's reported worldTick minus requestTick is about 40), then a use that places stone at 0 100 2 with a screenshot labelled v44_after_use. Expect the attack record with delay=40, the use record with screenshot=v44_after_use, and SCREENSHOT side=CLIENT action=saved file=screenshots/v44_after_use-<requestTick>.png. Run v43_platform first.

v44_inventory.description: Opens the inventory in survival, closes it, opens it in creative, closes it, then asks for two inventories in one tick: the second is refused screenOpen. Expect CLIENT_ACTION step=inventory result=done showing=net.minecraft.client.gui.inventory.GuiInventory, then showing=net.minecraft.client.gui.inventory.GuiContainerCreative, then one done and one refused reason=screenOpen. Run v43_platform first.

v44_tooltip_items.description: Puts the tooltip fixtures in the hotbar: slot 0 a diamond sword named Tooltip Sword with two lore lines, slot 4 paper with 25 lore lines (L1 to L25), slot 7 empty. Expect V44_TOOLTIP_ITEMS.
commands: replaceitem entity @s slot.hotbar.0 minecraft:diamond_sword 1 0 {display:{Name:"Tooltip Sword",Lore:["Lore one","Lore two"]}}

v44_tooltip.description: Tooltip views, one after another: slot 0 with a screenshot (line1 Tooltip Sword, the lore lines), slot 0 advanced (adds the item id line), slot 4 (lines=26 or more; the client's record has every lore line, the server's action=reported line1 to line20), slot 0 with shift (keys=shift; keysSeen=shift where the keyboard allows it), slot 7 (refused emptySlot), and slot 0 with showTicks=40 (closed=done about 40 ticks later). Run v44_tooltip_items first.

v44_tooltip_click.description: Opens the tooltip view of slot 0 for 200 ticks and cues the person to click and drag items in it. Inspects the inventory before and after. Expect the same slots and counts before and after, and the view closed=done or closed=person. Run v44_tooltip_items first.
commands: devtool checkpoint cue CLICK_ITEMS_NOW title sound
